title: Train braking failure
goal: Show the logic by which pneumatic and dynamic braking can both be unavailable.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Train unable to achieve required braking is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows both bogie brake-controller failures at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates pneumatic and dynamic brake loss branches.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/faulttree/ideal.svg (sha256 7bffbe71b8bd), source sha256 211776a792b2. Independent top-down fault tree, exact boolean-state enumeration and minimal cut-set extraction, slate event boxes, green AND/OR/INHIBIT gates, blue probabilities. Output stems and the single-child inhibit connection corrected following visual inspection; all declared conditions and basic probabilities retained. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
